title: Agent Guardrail: Policy, Budget & Replay for LLM Tool Calls
description: A policy-enforcement, cost-budgeting, tracing and deterministic-replay middleware for LLM agent tool calls, with an in-process guard() decorator and a FastAPI sidecar for non-Python agent stacks.

title: agent-trace-lens: Tracing & Timeline Visualization for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
description: A lightweight Python SDK, SQLite store, CLI, and FastAPI timeline viewer for recording and inspecting nested agent/tool/LLM spans across multi-agent runs.

title: agent-eval-harness: Evaluation & Regression-Testing Harness for LLM Agents
description: A pluggable-scorer, YAML-defined task suite runner with JSONL result storage and run-over-run regression detection, plus a CLI for gating CI on agent behavior.

title: agentflow-runtime: Durable Execution Runtime for LLM Agent Workflows
description: A dependency-free Python runtime giving multi-step LLM agent workflows automatic checkpointing, crash-safe resume, retry-with-backoff, and human-in-the-loop approval gates on top of a single SQLite store, plus a CLI to inspect and approve runs.

title: llm-semantic-cache: Semantic Caching Layer for LLM & Agent Calls
description: A dependency-free-by-default semantic cache for LLM and agent tool calls that matches near-duplicate prompts by embedding similarity, with SQLite-backed storage, TTL/LRU eviction, cost-saved tracking, a decorator API, and a CLI.

title: agent-memory-store: Long-Term Memory Layer for LLM Agents
description: A dependency-free episodic + semantic memory store for LLM agents with importance-weighted retrieval, decayed-importance forgetting, similarity clustering, and extractive consolidation into distilled semantic memories, plus a CLI and optional FastAPI HTTP API.

title: prompt-registry: Git-Like Version Control & Safe Rollout for LLM Prompt Templates
description: A dependency-free SQLite-backed registry for LLM prompt templates with immutable commit history, unified diffs, environment tags, one-call rollback, deterministic A/B routing between versions, a CLI, and an optional FastAPI HTTP service.

title: agent-code-sandbox: Secure Sandboxed Execution Engine for LLM Agent-Generated Code
description: A dependency-light secure execution sandbox for running LLM/agent-generated Python and shell snippets with CPU/memory/time limits, filesystem allowlisting, best-effort network isolation, structured result capture, and a JSONL audit trail, plus a CLI and optional FastAPI HTTP service.

title: llm-gateway: Unified Multi-Provider LLM Gateway with Routing, Failover & Cost Tracking
description: An OpenAI-compatible HTTP gateway and Python library that routes chat requests across multiple LLM providers by model/task rules, retries and fails over on errors, enforces per-key token-bucket rate limits and USD budgets, and tracks token/cost usage, with a CLI and FastAPI server.

title: context-compactor: Token-Budget-Aware Context Window Compaction for LLM Agents
description: A dependency-free library that fits growing LLM/agent transcripts into a fixed token budget by scoring message importance, always protecting pinned turns, and collapsing low-value runs into summaries instead of truncating, with a CLI and optional FastAPI HTTP service.

title: toolschema-lint: Static Analyzer for LLM Tool/Function-Calling Schemas
description: A dependency-free static analyzer that lints OpenAI, Anthropic, and MCP tool/function-calling schemas for missing or thin descriptions, ambiguous naming, unconstrained enums, JSON-schema type mismatches, and near-duplicate tool definitions, with a CLI, text/JSON/SARIF reporting, and pluggable severity config.

title: injection-radar: Prompt-Injection Detection & Sanitization for Untrusted LLM Input
description: A dependency-free heuristic scanner that detects instruction-override phrasing, spoofed chat delimiters, encoding-based obfuscation, and data-exfiltration links in tool outputs, RAG documents, and web content, then redacts or quarantines the risky spans, with a CLI and optional FastAPI sidecar.

title: llm-output-contract: Schema-Enforced Structured Output Parsing for LLMs
description: Extract, repair, coerce and validate messy LLM text into schema-valid structured data, with a self-healing retry loop.
